nodes.label: FRIDAY event contracts v1
nodes.rationale: Frozen contract documents current producers separately from reserved topic names; observed activity never establishes task completion, permission or user intent.

nodes.label: Transient event delivery
nodes.rationale: Process-local IDs reset on restart, history retains 200 envelopes and SSE has no durable replay guarantee. Each subscription has a separate ordered worker/200-event queue that drops its oldest item when full, keeping publishers independent of slow callbacks.

nodes.label: Official topics and connected producers
nodes.rationale: Connected producers are the activity monitor, system_events battery adapter, mood controller, plugin host and JSON todo plugin. Clipboard, scenes, focus, schedule, briefing and indexing names reserve contracts without claiming legacy producers emit them; activity payloads omit window titles.

nodes.label: Battery episode hysteresis
nodes.rationale: system_events consumes internal system.battery_reading and uses psutil only after 90 seconds without readings. Low at 20% and critical at 10% fire independently once per episode and reset only above 25%, including while charging; flags survive hot reload and absent batteries emit no transitions.

nodes.label: Mood arbitration and expiring card actions
nodes.rationale: Positive finite mood durations up to 3600 seconds use priority arbitration, latest equal priority and idle on expiry; live voice state retains visual precedence. Card actions return to the source plugin through authenticated HTTP and expire or fail when their plugin is disabled or unloaded.
